blocks.text: Aap chromosomes aur DNA ki bunyadi baatein jaante hain. Aap ko maloom hai ke genes DNA ke khaas hisse (segments) hain jo aik protein banane ki maloomat rakhte hain. Is chapter mein genes ko tafseel se parhenge, aur woh metabolic processes (cell ke andar chalne wale kimiyai amal) bhi jo gene ke kaam mein shamil hain.
Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic cells mein chromosomes ki banawat (structure) aur chemical composition (kimiyai tarkeeb) alag hoti hai. Is hisse mein hum sirf eukaryotic cells ke chromosomes parhenge.

Chromosomes patle, dhaage jaise structures hain jo DNA aur histone proteins se bane hote hain. Har species mein chromosomes ki tadaad aur shakal alag hoti hai. Kisi species ke chromosomes ka yeh poora set karyotype kehlata hai. Diploid jandaron ke body cells (somatic cells) mein chromosomes jore (pairs) mein hote hain; in joron ko homologous chromosomes kehte hain. Gametes (sex cells) mein chromosomes aadhe hote hain aur jore mein nahin hote.

Jab cell divide nahin ho raha hota (interphase), to us ke chromosomes alag alag nazar nahin aate. Woh khule (uncoiled) rehte hain aur aik bareek jaal banate hain jise chromatin kehte hain. Jab cell divide hone ki tayyari karta hai to DNA lipatna (coil hona) shuru karta hai: pehle histones ki chhoti units ke gird lipat-ta hai, phir yeh units mazeed lipat kar bohat ghani (condensed) shakal ban jati hain. Jitna zyada lipatna aur sukarna, utna hi structure mota aur chhota hota jata hai, aur aakhir mein ghane dhaage jaise chromosomes ban jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Chromatin kya hai, aur chromosomes kab saaf nazar aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Chromatin interphase (jab cell divide nahin ho raha) mein DNA aur histones ka bareek, khula jaal hai. Chromosomes tab nazar aate hain jab cell divide hone ki tayyari mein chromatin ko lapet kar mota aur chhota kar deta hai.

items: Chromosomes: DNA + histone proteins; kisi species ka poora set karyotype.
Somatic cells mein homologous jore; gametes mein aadhe chromosomes, jore nahin.
Interphase mein chromatin (khula jaal); division se pehle lipat kar chromosomes.
